units.function: Integration and pure tests for Heartbeat Run summary/detail projections, compatibility with an absent processGroupId schema descriptor, and size-bounding legacy result/event payloads.
units.dependencyDirection: heartbeatService reads Run rows and maps them into summary or detail shapes; a storage-bound helper recursively limits adapter event metadata before persistence. Tests use real Postgres for projections and a pure helper for event payloads.
units.keyDataModels: Run liveness summary, context snapshot, usage/result JSON, session/log/external process identifiers, processGroupId compatibility field, oversized-result truncation markers and bounded adapter event metadata.
units.lifecycle: List can return a lightweight row with usage, result, session, log, external-run and process fields nulled while retaining core status/error/context; getRun preserves small arbitrary result JSON but replaces oversized legacy payloads with a bounded summary/stdout and truncation receipt; event payloads retain bounded prompt/context metadata; an undefined linked-schema field maps processGroupId to null.
units.testAssessment: Five cases cover a missing ORM field descriptor, small detail fidelity, summary-field exclusion, oversized legacy result bounding and oversized adapter metadata truncation. Missing are route-level tenant/role authorization, cross-Company ID access, list ordering/pagination and invalid limits, error/context secret redaction, data classification, nested/cyclic/non-JSON values, Unicode/byte limits, compression bombs, attachment references, stable versioned schemas and performance assertions. Deleting the ORM property does not simulate querying an actually old database that lacks a selected column, so deployed-schema compatibility is only weakly demonstrated.
units.designRationale: Keep run lists fast and bounded, retain detail fidelity for normal payloads, prevent legacy rows or adapter events from creating unbounded API/storage amplification, and tolerate staged application/schema rollout.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs separate operational summaries and permission-scoped evidence details across cloud and local deployments without leaking prompts, private sessions, credentials, raw external identifiers or large provider payloads.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the summary/detail split, explicit field allowlists, size budgets and truncation receipts. Define versioned RunSummary and EvidenceDetail projections behind Company/role/data-contract authorization; store evidence by content-addressed reference with classification, retention and redaction policy. Apply structural redaction before byte bounding, never persist private reasoning or raw provider session/prompt by default, and expose stable error codes plus safe parameters rather than arbitrary error text. Prove migration compatibility against real prior schemas.
units.responsibilityConflict: The projection has no accountable-human or responsibility-contract fields. getRun accepts only a Run ID at this service boundary and tests do not establish Company/role authorization. Small arbitrary result JSON, error text, context snapshots and truncated prompts may still contain secrets or private reasoning; truncation limits volume but does not create authorized evidence or provenance.
